sidecar_info.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC (time.monotonic_ns), shared by the EtherCAT worker and the recorder

columns.frame_index: last dataset frame observed from this sample or an older one; -1 before the first
columns.frame_t_rel: t_rel of that frame's observation; NaN when frame_index is -1
columns.is_frame_sample: this sample is the one in that frame's observation.state
columns.sequence: successful SDK reads since connect (no hardware counter exists)
columns.read_start_ns/read_end_ns: monotonic bracket of the SDK read
columns.read_errors: failed SDK reads since connect, cumulative (they produce no sample)
columns.dropped: samples lost to a full worker queue since connect, cumulative
columns.command_*: last filtered joint command sent before this read: its sequence, send time, q (rad) and the unfiltered target it was moving to; null before the first command

frames.t_rel: s since the episode started, when the frame's observation was taken
frames.observation_ns/observation_unix_ns: monotonic / Unix time of the observation
frames.add_frame_ns: monotonic time the frame was written
frames.xhand_sequence: the sample in the frame's observation.state (null if none yet)

legacy_inline_10hz.description: recorded before the sidecar: the taxels were in observation.state at the dataset fps. One sample per frame, is_frame_sample always true, t_rel = frame timestamp; t_mono, read_*_ns, reset_sequence, read_errors, dropped and command_* are null.

sidecar_info.trex_style_note: Files are per re-cut episode. For episodes cut out of a longer recording, samples start 2 s before the episode's first frame (or at the recording start) and stop at the observation of its last frame; frame_index is renumbered to the new episode (-1 = before its first frame). t_rel / frame_t_rel / timestamps stay relative to the SOURCE recording. Episodes with tactile_interpolated=True (insert_game_object_cylinder, fruit_in_the_basket, unscrew_the_bottle) were recorded with one XHand sample per 10 Hz frame and no clock: their sidecar uses a nominal clock (frame k at k*100 ms) and adds 7 samples between frames (13.09 ms spacing, 76.4 Hz) with force and joints linearly interpolated between the two frame samples. Those rows have interpolated=True and available_ns = time of the next frame: they are synthetic and only usable once that frame is observed. 'values' (taxels) are zeros in these episodes (not recorded).
